$comment: Allowlisted demo personas. Keys are stable catalogue IDs; the browser never sends a customer_id. Stories describe recorded data; anything not in the data is marked as an assumption. Read by scripts/import-data.py and lib/personas.ts.

personas.label: Steady saver
personas.story: Regular salary, steady investing and almost no surprise costs. The original Koti demo account.

personas.label: Approved home purchase
personas.story: Applied for a mortgage in April 2026 and was approved in May for an apartment in Espoo. Whether this is a first home is a demo assumption.

personas.label: Mortgage declined: income
personas.story: A strong saver whose May 2026 application for a house was declined for insufficient income. What would it take next time?

personas.label: Recent mortgage approval
personas.story: Applied in August 2026 and was approved on 8 September. Most salary moves on to another account, so spending there is not visible.

personas.label: Mortgage declined: collateral
personas.story: Declined in February 2026 because the home's lending value did not cover the loan. Most salary moves on to another account.

personas.label: Tight budget
personas.story: A modest salary, frequent negative balances and housing that takes almost half of income.

personas.label: Generous everyday spender
personas.story: Restaurant spending in the top few percent of the dataset and a thin monthly margin.

personas.label: Hit by big one-offs
personas.story: Several large Home & Tech and Travel purchases and a small saving margin.
